item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00520","case1_error":"Inserts an unsupported $3,000 tax charge; 20% of the $5,000 pretax profit is $1,000.","case2_error":"Uses half a minute, the time per page, as the time for 100 pages, omitting the page-count factor.","reason":"The first introduces an unsupported tax amount; the second fails to scale a per-page time to the entire book.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00521","case1_error":"Treats four bags as four peanuts, omitting the 30 peanuts per bag.","case2_error":"Computes new women as 100 − 30 + 10 instead of adding 10 to the original 30 women.","reason":"The first confuses containers with their contents; the second uses an erroneous population-update relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00522","case1_error":"The final sum uses unsupported group totals and adds an extra 64 beyond the three customer groups.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 29 after correctly writing 65 − (22 + 24), which equals 19.","reason":"The first visibly changes the required aggregation with an extra term; the second supplies an incorrect number after a correct formula without intermediate calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00523","case1_error":"Incorrectly replaces 36 × 9 with 432 while evaluating the correctly written volume expression.","case2_error":"Extends only the width; whether “each side” means width boundaries or all bathroom sides is materially ambiguous.","reason":"The first has a clear numerical evaluation error. The second depends on ambiguous extension wording, which the reference does not resolve.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00524","case1_error":"Uses Frank’s 12 sold apples as his remaining apples instead of subtracting them from 36.","case2_error":"Reports eight books sold as eight customers, omitting division by two books per customer.","reason":"The first confuses a removed portion with its complement; the second fails to convert book count into customer count.","judgment":"different"}]}
